dataset: Statistics On Occupancy Rates and Revenues for Real Estate Endowments at the State Level

source.organization: General Authority of Islamic Affairs, Endowments & Zakat
source.methodology: The Monthly reports regarding the rental status of the Authority's properties from contracting companies and direct contracts with the Authority are utilized to derive rental rates and revenues.

coverage.area: All Emirates of the state except the Emirate of Abu Dhabi

occupancy_rate.description: Proportion of rental units that are occupied, expressed as a decimal (0 to 1)

occupancy_rate_pct.description: Proportion of rental units that are occupied, expressed as a percentage
occupancy_rate_pct.note: Used in all_records.json (flat format). Equals occupancy_rate * 100.

revenues_collected.description: Total funds collected from leasing rental units for that emirate and month

revenues_collected_aed.description: Total funds collected from leasing rental units for that emirate and month
revenues_collected_aed.note: Used in all_records.json (flat format). Same value as revenues_collected.

emirate.description: The UAE emirate the data pertains to (excludes Abu Dhabi)

terms.calculation: Number of occupied units out of total units

terms.definition: Total funds acquired by the Authority via leasing and investment agreements for the Authority’s properties
Residential, commercial, and industrial rental units, buildings, and spaces that the Authority leases out.
Funds collected from leasing rental units
Companies responsible for managing leasing operations on behalf of the General Authority of Islamic Affairs, Endowments & Zakat
terms.calculation: Number of contracting real estate companies
